name: codeshare
description: Free, code-based peer-to-peer file transfer over WebRTC. No accounts, no storage, no paid services.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace client"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace client && npm run lint --workspace server
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace server && npm run test --workspace client
